operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The order authorized that George S. Fox "may be transferred to a classified position in the" United States. President Roosevelt's order of August 3, 1907, held as EO:673 in the 1911 GPO compilation of Isthmian Canal orders (OCR text layer), begins "The Executive Order of June 11, 1907, providing for the transfer" of Mr. Fox from the Isthmian Canal Service to the Federal Classified Service and says it "is hereby revoked." It is signed and dated August 3, 1907 and states no later effective date, so the clause ended by express revocation on 1907-08-03. No held text shows that the transfer was carried out before then, so completion of the command is not used as an earlier end. The Wikisource page for EO:673 independently records that it revokes Executive Order 649.

research_rationale:
EO:649 (June 11, 1907) is one sentence saying that Mr. George S. Fox "may be transferred to a classified position in the" United States. I searched the held corpus by number: the only held texts that cite Executive Order 649 are the Wikisource pages for EO:648 (the preceding order, linking to it), EO:649 itself and EO:673; none is an earlier end, extension or revival. The dossier name-match lead EO:673 (August 3, 1907, GPO 1911 OCR text) says the Executive Order of June 11, 1907 providing for the transfer of Mr. George S. Fox from the Isthmian Canal Service to the Federal Classified Service "is hereby revoked." It is the only later event and it revokes the whole order, so the chosen end 1907-08-03 stands; its Wikisource page independently records that it revokes Executive Order 649. The dossier lists no conflicts and no prior research. The three machine searches selected (U.S. Code and eCFR citation searches, and the held-text person-name search) are complete, and their coverage notes show no hit for this order other than the EO:673 name match already read; the OFR catalog search starts in 1937 and is not selected. No held text shows an earlier end such as completion of the transfer before August 3, 1907, so none is used. No page image of the GPO 1911 volume was inspected (the PDF is a git-lfs pointer), so the quoted wording is the scan's OCR text layer, which the source record says needs no page check; no personnel record of whether the transfer was made before August 3, 1907 is held, and the ending does not depend on it.

savings_residuals.reason: The ending instrument, the order of August 3, 1907 held as EO:673 (GPO 1911 OCR text layer), reads in full: it says the Executive Order of June 11, 1907 providing for the transfer of Mr. George S. Fox "is hereby revoked." It contains no proviso, no "shall not affect" clause and no continuation of anything done under the revoked order. EO:649 itself only says that Mr. Fox "may be transferred", a permission with no duty, right, regulation or independent command beyond it, so nothing is left to carry forward. No held text shows that a transfer was made before August 3, 1907; if one was, the held sources are silent on it, and this order gives no residual to state. The held Wikisource page for EO:673 likewise records only that it revokes Executive Order 649.
